items.title: Anthropic raises $13B Series F at $183B valuation
items.summary: Anthropic has completed a $13 billion Series F led by ICONIQ, co-led by Fidelity and Lightspeed, valuing the company at $183 billion post-money.
items.summaryZh: Anthropic 以 183B 美元估值筹集 13B 轮 F 轮融资。# Anthropic 以 183B 投后估值筹集 13B 轮 F 轮融资 Anthropic 已完成由 ICONIQ 领投的 130 亿美元 F 轮融资。本次融资后 Anthropic 估值为 1830 亿。
